scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; const execPath = process.env.npm_execpath || ''; if (!ua.includes('pnpm/') && !execPath.includes('pnpm')) { console.error('检测到正在使用 npm。请使用 pnpm install'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build-staging: pnpm --dir .. exec vite build --config web/vite.config.js web --mode staging
scripts.build: pnpm --dir .. exec vite build --config web/vite.config.js web
scripts.preview: pnpm --dir .. exec vite preview --config web/vite.config.js web
